title: On the heat flow conjecture for random matrices
summary: We prove two families of distinguished cases of the heat flow conjecture for random matrices of Hall-Ho: elliptic Gaussian sources with planar targets, and deterministic Hermitian sources with targets on the boundary of the covariance disk. In particular, the empirical zero measure of the heat-evolved characteristic polynomial of a complex Ginibre matrix converges almost surely to the semicircle law.
